boundaries: A mixed-developer formative protocol is not role-specific hiring validation.
A draft protocol has no participant-collection authority.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One formative pilot or named-role validation study.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Study Protocol meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It says who joins, what happens, what is measured and how results will be interpreted before answers arrive.

boundary_conditions: A mixed-developer formative protocol is not role-specific hiring validation.
A draft protocol has no participant-collection authority.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Study Protocol is a versioned prospective plan fixing population, eligibility, purposes, procedures, measures, assignment, exclusions, analysis, stopping rules, custody and decision owners before a pilot or study collects data.
